tree_frog_base_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Flexible anti-scratch suction base (95A Black TPU). Sliced at 100% density with top solid infill layers forced flat to form an airtight sealing perimeter gasket, ensuring creeping road dust and harsh winter moisture are locked away from the vehicle paint.

national_flag_strata_asa.structural_purpose: UV-stabilized national color strata skin (Matte Colored ASA). Hardcodes an explicit 0.15mm interfacial co-polymer compression overlap where the colored flag layers anchor directly into the active TPU jigsaw pins, maximizing melt-welding cross-adhesion to prevent highway delamination while completely maintaining a locked 0.15mm SUTURE_GAP boundary regardless of dimensional changes.
